document.title: HYDRA-UMC-SERVER connections
document.description: The list of the clients that connect to a HYDRA-UMC server and the history of their sign-ins. This document is generated from contracts/sources/connections.routes.json and the closed ConnectionClient and ConnectionEvent schemas by tools/contract_source.py; do not edit it by hand. An administrator sees every client and, when the server records addresses, the address and the user agent; any other account sees only its own entries and never an address.

routes.summary: List the clients the server has seen

query.name: kind
query.description: Only the clients of this kind.

query.name: user
query.description: Only the clients of this account. Honoured for administrators; any other account always gets its own entries.

query.name: active
query.description: 1 or true: only the clients with an open session.

400.description: The kind is not one of the client kinds.

routes.summary: List the history of the sign-ins of the clients

query.name: kind
query.description: Only the events of this kind of client.

query.name: action
query.description: Only the events of this action.

query.name: user
query.description: Only the events of this account. Honoured for administrators; any other account always gets its own entries.

query.name: before
query.description: Only the events with an id lower than this one, to page backwards.

query.name: limit
query.description: The most events to answer with.

400.description: The kind or the action is unknown, or the limit or the before is not a whole number.
